rungs.name: Mucha verga
rungs.definition: Solves reliably while respecting the larger system.

rungs.name: No te mames
rungs.definition: Helps the whole system become more capable without requiring more central control.

gates.definition: Mission, owner, outcome and operating scope are explicit.
A bounded local operation respects current host-enforced authority.
Work is bounded and its actual stop/resource controls are known.
Result or failure is visible and traceable to the operation.
A useful task outcome is checked rather than inferred from activity.
Relevant failure, missing-input and interrupted paths are handled.
Consumer receives the result, context, limitations and next action.
Work finishes, checkpoints or escalates usefully within its bounds.
Larger-system invariants and neighbor boundaries are preserved.
Repeated relevant observations satisfy the scoped evidence plan.
Failure, cancellation and recovery are bounded and checked.
UI, APIs and reports expose consistent current facts and limitations.
Two distinct consumers accept the same governed capability contract.
Consumers gain observed useful capability, with comparison limits.
Comparable work needs no more routine central steering; costs are visible.
Adoption, operation, versioning, support and exit are maintainable.
